recipe.visualDefinition: A circular emblem featuring a central collage of architectural monuments rendered in a high-contrast, monochromatic brown palette, framed by bold arched typography and horizontal hatching.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric circles framing a central architectural collage
Arched text following the upper and lower curves of the seal
Horizontal line patterns providing texture and depth in the background
Monochromatic sepia-brown color scheme against an off-white field
coreInvariants: Three-tier typographic layout (top arch, center bar, bottom arch)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central architectural elements occupy the middle circle; typography occupies the outer ring and a horizontal bisecting bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central monuments (statue and dome) act as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion from the top arched text, down through the central imagery, to the bottom text, reinforced by concentric rings.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The off-white background outside the seal provides breathing room for the dense, textured interior.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep chocolate brown used for shadows and line work.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Tan/beige mid-tones used for highlights and halftone fills.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for the outer background and extreme highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation monochromatic scheme relying on value contrast and texture density.
paletteRestrictions: No vibrant colors except for small corner metadata badges

letterConstructionRules: Heavy blocky forms with thick outlines
Arched distortion to fit circular paths
Inner shadow or 'drop' effect to create 3D depth
Consistent stroke weight within each word block
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tapered toward the center of the circle in the arched sections
Slab serifs on the central horizontal text are exaggerated and squared

composition.position: Arched top, horizontal center, arched bottom

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying the arc and orientation of a single heavy-weight family to create structural hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy slab-serif foundation for the central text.
Provides the condensed, heavy sans-serif skeleton for the arched text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a circular seal graphic in monochromatic chocolate brown and tan. The center should feature a high-contrast, etched-style collage of monuments including a seated statue, an obelisk, and a domed building. Use horizontal hatching and halftone dots for shading. Surround this with concentric rings and a horizontal bar across the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, uppercase custom lettering. Arch the first word along the top inner ring. Place the second word horizontally inside the central bar. Arch the third word along the bottom inner ring. Use a heavy slab-serif style with thick outlines and a 3D drop-shadow effect.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia/brown?
Does the text follow the circular geometry of the seal?
Are the monuments rendered with high-contrast shadows and hatching?
Is the overall composition centered and symmetrical?

adjustableVariables: Specific architectural monuments featured in the center
Thickness of the concentric border rings
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top left corner
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent monochromatic value range
Ensure text is legible despite the heavy warping
Verify that the hatching lines do not create moiré patterns
Confirm the central collage feels integrated into the seal structure
recipe.reuseFormula: Circular Seal + Monochromatic Sepia + Etched Architectural Collage + Arched Heavy Typography + Horizontal Hatching Texture
